title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).

Education

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) – Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  • Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are excited to introduce a remarkable opportunity at Lonza as the Head of Distribution Sales, Americas. This position will be crucial in directing and leading our distributor network across North, Central, and South America. This is your chance to join a world-class team, contributing to outstanding growth and innovation at Lonza!

Key responsibilities:

  • Build and implement a comprehensive indirect sales approach for the Americas, emphasizing distribution and agency channels in line with global objectives.

  • Identify and capitalize on regional growth opportunities to increase revenue and market share through distribution.

  • Lead the channel partner selection process across the AMERs region and build a high-performing network of distributor sales professionals.

  • Foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement across the distributor and agent network, setting clear performance expectations and providing regular feedback.

  • Develop and implement channel programs to improve partner engagement and monitor distributor performance, offering insights and recommendations for improvement.

  • Lead the transition from conventional distributor relationships to a more strategic approach, backed by successful change management and adherence to Lonza CHI processes.

  • Collaborate with the Global Distribution Leader to improve global initiatives and oversight in the AMER region.

  • Collaborate with direct sales teams and internal stakeholders—including marketing, product management, and customer service—to ensure cohesive and aligned sales operations.

  • Oversee distribution contract negotiations and governance in close coordination with the global distribution leader.

  • Establish and manage key performance indicators to evaluate indirect sales outcomes and provide regular reports and insights to senior leadership on performance, white space, and growth opportunities.

  • Apply data-driven decision-making to continuously improve the distribution network.

Key requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required; Msc or MBA or equivalent experience preferred.

  • Strong understanding of principal-distributor dynamics in competitive and technical B2B environments.

  • Proven track record of developing and implementing sales strategies that boost revenue growth, especially with distributors and agents.

  • Analytical and data-driven approach, with expertise in analyzing sales analytics and reporting tools.

  • Willingness to travel within the region, up to 50%, as required.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

description:
Responsável pelo planejamento e gestão do departamento de Transportes, para todos os CDs Profarma, visando a implantação de novos projetos e avaliação dos processos de expedição e distribuição com foco na melhoria da produtividade nas operações, para oferecer o melhor nível de serviço aos nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Garantir a entrega dos nossos produtos com a maior qualidade possível e dentro dos prazos acordados com nossos clientes - Através do acompanhamento e atingimento das metas dos indicadores de nível de serviço (Qualidade na entrega, CAP 10, CAP 25).
  • Controlar o orçamento da área de Transportes, garantindo o menor custo possível de acordo com a qualidade esperada. - Através do monitoramento das despesas lançadas garantindo que não haja lançamentos indevidos;
  • Implantar novos projetos / revisão de processos que visem melhorar a produtividade;
  • Revisão dos contratos de transporte,
  • Coordenar a aplicação de investimentos na área de transportes visando a melhoria de nível de serviço em regiões críticas. - Por meio da abertura de BIDs para contratação / negociação de novos serviços ou melhoria dos existentes;
  • Levantamento junto a área comercial das regiões foco das melhorias e quais serão os retornos obtidos com os investimentos (Ex. Crescimento das vendas, do lucro bruto, positivação, etc). ;
  • Gerir os contratos de transporte em vigência nas operações de distribuição. - Através do acompanhamento das negociações de reajuste de contrato conduzidas por Suprimentos;
  • Geração de aditivos para adequação de escopo da operação;
  • Renovação de contratos próximos a expirar;
  • Implantar novos projetos visando a otimização de processos e informações (ganho de produtividade) dentro da área de Expedição e Distribuição. - Através do desenvolvimento de melhorias dentro dos sistemas da cia com suporte de TI;
  • Avaliação de novas tecnologias existentes e sua aplicabilidade na área;
  • Benchmarking sobre melhores práticas de mercado.;
  • Orientar e desenvolver a equipe de trabalho. - Através do treinamento das atividades desempenhadas;
  • Aplicação de feedback para os colaboradores;
  • Comunicação frequente em relação à informações relevantes da área de Logística e demais setores.

ConhecimentosTécnicos:

Gestão de projetos - Conhecimento;

Gestão de Contratos de Transporte - Domínio;

Iniciamos essa jornada, em 1961, com a Profarma Distribuidora de Produtos Farmacêuticos e trabalhamos duro todos os dias para entregar saúde, expandindo e diversificando nossa participação no ecossistema de saúde. A partir de 2013, a Companhia iniciou sua trajetória no varejo farmacêutico através da Rede d1000, formada pelas bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Tamoio e Rosário.

Atuamos da negociação e distribuição de medicamentos e produtos de higiene e beleza para milhares de farmácias brasileiras ao relacionamento direto nos balcões das lojas. Desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros.

Da necessidade de nossos clientes e consumidores aos processos de atendimento – presenciais ou digitais – nossas equipes se dedicam incansavelmente para gerar bons negócios e as melhores experiências no acesso à saúde e bem-estar com atuação inclusiva, sustentável e socialmente engajada.

title: Médico do Trabalho - Macaé (RJ)
description:
Junte-se ao DOF como nosso próximo Médico do Trabalho ?

Estamos em busca de um Médico do Trabalho para atuar no suporte à saúde ocupacional de nossas operações no Brasil, contribuindo diretamente para a segurança, o bem-estar e a sustentabilidade de nossas equipes, tanto em ambiente onshore quanto offshore.

Aqui, você fará parte de uma organização global sólida, com forte cultura de HSEQ, processos bem estabelecidos e compromisso genuíno com as pessoas. Buscamos um profissional com visão sistêmica, postura ética e capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com diferentes áreas da companhia.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na gestão da saúde ocupacional, garantindo o cumprimento da legislação vigente;
  • Realizar e supervisionar exames ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos, retorno ao trabalho, mudança de função e demissionais);
  • Apoiar as rotinas de HSEQ, contribuindo para a prevenção de riscos ocupacionais;
  • Atuar em conformidade com as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) aplicáveis;
  • Interface com áreas internas, fornecedores e clientes, quando necessário;
  • Apoiar operações offshore, incluindo atendimento a demandas relacionadas à PETROBRAS, quando aplicável.

Formação Acadêmica / Técnica

(Education / Technical Training)

  • Graduação em Medicina;
  • Formação complementar em Medicina do Trabalho;
  • Registro ativo no respectivo Conselho Profissional (CRM);
  • Especialização em Medicina do Trabalho, com registro da especialidade no Conselho Federal de Medicina (RQE);
  • Conhecimento das rotinas de HSEQ;
  • Conhecimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs);
  • Conhecimento das normas ISO 9001, ISO 18001 / ISO 45001 e ISO 14001.

Habilidades Técnicas

(Technical Skills)

  • Demonstrar visão sistêmica;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e de forma colaborativa;
  • Experiência profissional pode compensar a ausência de alguma competência formalmente comprovada.

Experiência

(Experience)

  • Experiência com atividades relacionadas à Medicina do Trabalho;
  • Desejável experiência com suporte à saúde ocupacional em operações offshore;
  • Desejável experiência em atendimento a contratos e demandas da PETROBRAS.

Comentários Adicionais

(Additional Comments)

  • Inglês em nível intermediário ou avançado;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office.

Localização

Essa posição será baseada em Macaé .

Carga horária comercial (Seg - Sex) - regime híbrido (3x2)

OBS: Apenas o primeiro mês será 100% presencial

Quem somos:

A DOF é uma das principais fornecedoras de serviços marítimos e submarinos integrados para o mercado global de energia offshore. Combinamos expertise, ativos e tecnologia para executar operações integradas submersas e offshore de forma segura e confiável - sempre.

Com uma equipe multinacional de aproximadamente 6.000 pessoas e a maior frota mundial de Embarcações de Apoio à Construção (CSVs) e embarcações de alto padrão de Rebocadores de Manuseio de Âncoras (AHTS), apoiamos nossos parceiros com alcance global, escala e capacidade líder no setor. Nossos centros operacionais e unidades de negócios estão na Noruega, Dinamarca, Reino Unido, EUA, Singapura, Brasil, Argentina, Canadá, Angola e Austrália.

Na DOF, você entra em uma organização global confiável, onde segurança, trabalho em equipe e integridade vêm em primeiro lugar. Oferecemos forte crescimento na carreira, desenvolvimento de apoio e uma cultura que valoriza inclusão, reconhecimento e conexão. Construa uma carreira significativa em um ambiente de trabalho que coloque as pessoas em primeiro lugar.

Na DOF, valorizamos a pessoa certa para a função, com base em um alinhamento genuíno com a nossa cultura e propósito. Sabemos, por meio de estudos, que minorias frequentemente não se candidatam caso não atendam a 100% dos requisitos — e queremos mudar isso!

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e positivo é uma prioridade para nós. Por isso, esta vaga também é extensiva a pessoas com deficiência (PCD) . Se este for o seu caso, atualize seu currículo com o número do CID.

title: Supervisor de Logística
description:
Conheça sua missão:

  • Supervisiona e planeja a demanda diária de acordo com o cronograma de entregas estabelecido. Realiza um controle minucioso por meio do painel de visão detalhada, garantindo a execução de todas as etapas dos pedidos, que incluem separação, conferência, faturamento, transbordo, carregamento, roteirização, baixa adequada e registro correto dos motivos para eventuais falhas nas entregas;
  • Em situações de furo de estoque, acompanha atentamente a gestão do setor, envolvendo a consideração de oferecer produtos similares ou a confirmação da ruptura, visando assegurar que a expedição seja realizada na data de entrega acordada;
  • Garante o fluxo da demanda de retirada imediata do dia, identificando oportunidades para melhorar a produtividade e a qualidade. Também monitora os pedidos com prazos de retirada expirados, tomando as ações necessárias, como o contato com o cliente ou o cancelamento do pedido;
  • Mantém uma interação diária com a torre de controle e também reuniões mensais, avaliando as ocorrências e prestando suporte à equipe de administração logística, com acompanhamento atento do gestor;
  • Exerce supervisão sobre a equipe ADM, garantindo que todas as entregas programadas para o dia tenham Documento de Transporte (DT). Em casos de falta desse documento, atua diretamente junto à transportadora para garantir que o processo de roteirização seja concluído, assegurando que nosso indicador OTIF (On-Time In-Full) não seja prejudicado;
  • Utiliza o painel de roteirização para extrair informações relevantes que embasam suas decisões, antecipando-se a possíveis problemas apontados em ressalvas feitas pelos clientes e agilizando as soluções;
  • Busca constantemente maior agilidade e eficiência na resolução de casos de furo de estoque, aplicando análises cuidadosas e tomando decisões assertivas com relativa autonomia;
  • Identifica os gargalos operacionais e organiza a equipe de acordo com os picos de maior fluxo, assegurando que o tempo de separação dos pedidos e a permanência do cliente no local estejam alinhados com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa;
  • Demonstra habilidade na análise de relatórios, propondo ações destinadas a aprimorar os processos existentes e alcançar os resultados almejados;
  • Contribui com o Gerente de Operações Logísticas, selecionando, contratando, animando, desenvolvendo e retendo conforme avaliação e necessidades do setor;
  • Atua na busca contínua por oportunidades de melhoria, antecipa-se a problemas, contribuindo com soluções adequadas;
  • Colabora com seu gestor na elaboração de relatórios voltados para o aumento da produtividade e o alcance dos objetivos do setor;
  • Torna-se uma referência para a equipe, compartilhando os números do setor e atingindo as metas estabelecidas;
  • Orienta os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de gestão, e supervisiona a realização das atividades. Acompanha o controle de estoque, incluindo endereçamentos, armazenamento de posições e realizações de inventários;
  • Assegura o bom uso e manutenção das ferramentas que estão à disposição da suas equipes (Cintas, Etiquetadoras, Coletores de dados, Empilhadeiras, Paleteiras, Rádios, Impressoras, Computadores, etc);
  • Garantir a eficácia de todos os processos relacionados à gestão de inventário, tanto rotativo quanto geral. Monitora a execução dos processos de movimentações, transitórios, endereçamento e negativos e promove a disseminação da cultura de endereçamento correto;
  • Assegura o cumprimento do procedimento de furo de estoque e mantem a vigilância constante sobre o monitoramento de deficiências de estoque no sistema e prepara relatórios semanais sobre o tema. Auxilia no processo de treinamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores (loja e logística) para uso dos recursos e aderência aos processos de movimentação e armazenagem de material;
  • Representa papel central na luta anti demarca e apresenta relatórios de maior profundidade durante as reuniões de briefing e, é um modelo de eficácia no contra poder e na adoção de boas práticas;
  • Orientar os colaboradores da equipe para o plano diário de operação, colaborar para a prevenção de perdas, zelar pela qualidade e conservação do estoque de mercadorias, zelar pelo o pátio logístico, direcionando sua equipe para mantê-lo sempre limpo e organizado;
  • Garante que todas as mercadorias sejam conferidas e estejam em perfeitas condições. monitorar a coleta das devoluções conforme acordos comerciais estabelecidos, orientando a equipe para melhor comunicação e seguimento dos processos;
  • Instrui a equipe a comunicar ao suporte de cadastros qualquer discrepância nos produtos cadastrados, como forma de prevenir erros no estoque. Desenvolve escala de trabalho, sempre verificando a necessidade operacional e normas legislativas;
  • Conduz a sua equipe na delimitação adequada dos espaços conforme o produto a ser recebido para otimizar o gerenciamento da conferência e da armazenagem, orienta os terceiros, responsáveis pela paletização, assegurando que esse processo seja realizado corretamente, seguindo os padrões definidos;
  • Garante o registro completo dos fretes FOB e certifica se todos foram pagos corretamente, efetuando o controle do pallets em débito com os fornecedores, garantindo a transparência nas relações comerciais e o cumprimento das obrigações;
  • Cria agendas de treinamentos para os demais setores, sobre o processo de devoluções via acordo comercial, visando instruí-los sobre o procedimento padrão de paletização e conferência, garantindo que todos sigam os protocolos estabelecidos.

Para fazer parte do nosso time você deve ter:

  • Superior completo em Administração, Logística ou correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em logística, produto, em sistemas de gerenciamento de armazém, legislação e regulação aplicados;
  • CNH (qualquer categoria);
  • Habilitação para operar empilhadeira, conforme modelo e requisitos do equipamento.

title: Brazil - Remote: Tech Lead
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the \'Control Room\' and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together, ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s \'Visualizations\' and that the \'Data Pipelines\' are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert': When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Qualifications

  • 1 0+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar atividades de diligenciamento com a finalidade de assegurar os cumprimentos de todos os eventos e condições contratuais constantes no Pedido de Compra;

  • Apoio na execução das atividades referentes ao encerramento do PCs, bem como no arquivamento de sua documentação;
  • Demais atividades necessárias ao suporte à gestão de contratos de bens de operação e/ou de investimento.
  • Nível Técnico ou Superior.
  • Pacote Office Avançado (Word, Excel e Power Point);
  • Sistema SAP e suas derivações (Ariba, 4HANA, YARD, etc);

  • Experiência na atuação em suprimentos, logística, supply chain ou áreas correlatas,
  • Desejável experiência em empresas de médio ou grande porte;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Regime Remoto

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator
description:
Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA's exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams’ time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

Your Profile

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Tech Talent Program 2026
description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Job Summary

We are looking for curious, analytical, and forward-thinking problem-solvers to join our Subsurface Imaging team at Viridien as part of our Tech Talent Program 2026 in a full-time position.

In this role, you will apply your knowledge of physics, mathematics, and technology to solve challenges across energy, infrastructure, and Earth data solutions. Working alongside industry experts, you will contribute to cutting-edge projects that redefine how we explore and understand the Earth’s subsurface.

To support your success, we provide structured onboarding, comprehensive technical training, and ongoing mentorship. You will learn how to transform raw seismic data into high-resolution 3D subsurface models, generating insights that support sustainable exploration and environmental stewardship.

Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced physics, mathematics, and geoscience principles to process and interpret seismic data.
  • Use state-of-the-art imaging techniques and high-performance computing (HPC) to tackle complex geophysical challenges.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and improve algorithms, tools, and workflows.
  • Work closely with Research and Software Development teams to help shape next-generation technologies.
  • Contribute to scientific publications, present findings, and support innovation across the organization and the wider geophysical community.

About the Team

You will join a supportive and collaborative team working on real-world geophysical challenges.

Our culture is driven by science, sparked by collaboration, and propelled by ambition — pillars that reflect what makes working at Viridien unique and exciting. They shape how we learn from each other, tackle complex problems, and grow together in an environment that encourages curiosity, teamwork, and continuous development from day one.

Qualifications

  • A PhD or Master’s degree in Geophysics, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, and problem-solving skills.
  • A collaborative mindset, curiosity, and a genuine interest in innovation and continuous learning.

Benefits

At Viridien, we support both your professional growth and personal well-being:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Meal voucher.
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu therapy available on site.
  • TotalPass fitness program.
  • Hybrid work model (up to 2 remote days per week).
  • Birthday day off.
  • Christmas gift card.
  • Educational assistance and language learning programs.
  • Continuous development through our Learning Hub, offering both technical and behavioral training.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond.

We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly.

We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation, we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

title: Brazil - Remote: Data Engineer - Platform & Pipelines
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from "Bronze" (Raw) to "Silver" (Cleaned) and "Gold" (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute: Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

  • The Structured Thinker: You love organizing data. You understand the importance of schemas, data typing, and normalization.
  • Quality Obsessive: You don\'t just move data; you test it. You implement checks to ensure no bad data reaches the Gold layer.
  • Pipeline Builder: You view data engineering as software engineering. You write modular, reusable code for your transformations.

Must Haves

  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
    • Complete Bachelor\'s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
    • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
    • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks.
    • Experience implementing Medallion/Delta Lake architectures.
    • Strong SQL and Python skills.
    • Advanced English communication skills.

Good To Have

  • Experience with Unity Catalog or other governance tools.
  • Familiarity with dbt (data build tool).
  • Background in processing telemetry or sensor data.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that, for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with theOURCES with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long‑lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.(target>
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
    1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
    2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender‑based violence and improving моделей of women in Brazilian society.
    3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post‑tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

YOUR PROFILE

Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations:
  • Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of working in women’s football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women’s football stakeholders.
Legacy Development
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organising, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post‑event reporting.
Communication & Stakeholder Relations
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high‑level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience
  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Manager, Volunteer System
description:
Manager, Volunteer System

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑The‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! This information is provided for prospective applicants. Benefits details can be found at the university benefits site.

Job Purpose

The Building Manager ensures the smooth operation of teaching, research and office space, and acts as a liaison between the Chemistry Department, Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), and Physical Facilities Management (PFM) team. The candidate must have a strong understanding of building systems and chemistry laboratories. The successful candidate will oversee and participate in needed maintenance and repairs of the building to ensure functional integrity for teaching and research.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include staff, students and faculty.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serves as the main contact for the Chemistry Department for routine and emergency maintenance and repair requests.
  • Monitor the building condition (particularly the laboratory space) by performing regular inspections, and schedule routine maintenance (e.g., fume hoods, HVAC, and roof). Report maintenance or cleaning needs to the department staff.
  • Assist the department with submission of work orders to PFM as needed and monitor progress.
  • Oversee the work of vendors and contractors by maintaining standing orders and managing professional relationships; and provide building access to outside vendors and contractors.
  • Work closely with faculty and staff to provide solutions to facility-related problems.
  • Design, plan, or assist in renovation/modification projects to meet specific department or research needs or to correct building problems, requiring an understanding of structural design and department needs.
  • Respond to building emergencies, and serve as the primary emergency contact 24 hours a day throughout the year, including semester breaks, weekends, and holidays.
  • Assist faculty, staff and graduate students with shipping, receiving, and moving tasks.
  • Installation of some laboratory equipment, cabinetry, shelving, etc.
  • Communicate with the appropriate Facilities staff when the work order is not completed within a reasonable time frame.
  • Serve as a liaison to Public Safety, PFM, EHS, and other university entities in emergency response situations and for safety-related topics.
  • Supervision of small groups of student workers.

Laboratory Safety

  • Troubleshoot and advise on problems that arise regarding the safety of building or laboratory facilities.
  • Check safety showers and eyewash stations weekly to ensure their working conditions.
  • Remain up to date with University safety training.
  • Act as a department contact for Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS).
  • Understand hazardous material safety guidelines per University protocols.
  • Work with EHS on proper handling of hazardous waste materials from teaching and research laboratories.
  • Assist in chemical/solvent deliveries as necessary.
  • Develop and execute response plans for safety, security, and business continuity.

Perform other duties as assigned by the Chemistry Department.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five years of related experience in a variety of trades relevant to general building functions including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and mechanical; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Knowledge of building materials and methods.
  • Proven supervisory skills.
  • Abilities to use Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel and Outlook.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to work with faculty members, staff, and students.
  • Valid driver’s license (ability to drive University vehicles).
  • Ability to climb ladders, kneel, reach above the shoulder, stand and/or walk for extended periods of time and may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in specifying and purchasing parts or equipment.
  • Experience working in chemistry laboratory/research setting.
  • Understanding and minor maintenance of water purification systems, laboratory hoods, and electronic locksets.
  • Ability to engage, connect, and work with diverse student, administrative, and faculty populations and provide a commitment to the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion in an educational setting.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$65,000-$75,000

title: Metering Engineer
description:
This position will support FPSO operations by overseeing and ensuring the integrity of all metering systems. It will involve monitoring system performance, validating data, and providing daily operational support. The role will also act as the Technical Authority for metering, ensuring compliance with technical and regulatory requirements, including ANP and INMETRO standards.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring that all fluid metering systems at FPSO are performed in accordance with the technical requirements and legal deadlines, meeting the requirements outlined in Joint Resolution ANP / INMETRO 01: 2013 (RTM).
  • Provide technical support daily, in relation to measurement problems in the FPSO.
  • Participate/assist in metering audits.
  • Act as Technical Authority to measurement issues.
  • Verify that FPSO operator’s procedures and manuals are in accordance with current ANP, ISO and other relevant standards for offshore oil and natural gas flow measurement (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Manage and monitor the status of the flow metering systems (fiscal, allocation and operational).
  • Conduct critical analysis of failure reports, calibrations and periodic maintenance of fiscal, allocation and custody transfer metering systems in accordance with RTM and applicable standards.
  • Verify, validate and submit data (failure reports, flow computer data, well test reports and monthly production report) related to the FPSO metering systems to ANP.
  • Keep updated the measurement points registered in the SFP (ANP production system).
  • Validate offloading measurement reports.
  • Verify the operational history of seal removal and installation.
  • Verify that the FPSO operator is following calibration plans, uncertainty calculations, and required flow computer upgrades.
  • Verify / validate in case of measurement system failure the volume estimate as specified in ANP resolutions.
  • Verify / monitor backups of measurement equipment information, fault history, equipment replacement, and parameter changes.
  • Carry out the planning and control of the sample collection service for chemical analysis, interface with logistics for loading / unloading materials related to the samples, and, if necessary, validate the results of PVT and chromatographic analysis. After validation, monitor the results/inform the need to update the flow computers.
  • Follow up the routines to keep the Metering Management System in operation without non-conformities.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Automation, Petroleum, Production, Chemical Engineering or related.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Good understanding and knowledge of FPSO marine & process systems.
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc.
  • Advanced English (oral and written).

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Sobre a vaga

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Nesse papel você será responsável pelo suporte técnico prestado aos usuários, pela manutenção e implantação de equipamentos, programas e sistemas, e pelo planejamento e desempenho da área de TI na unidade. description:

The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline‑specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project‑driven environment
  • Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
  • Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
  • Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels

Responsibilities

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive‑level reporting
  • Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi‑phase projects
  • Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi‑dimensional models that support real‑time decision‑making
  • Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
  • Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
  • Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
  • Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
  • Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long‑term project planning and risk mitigation
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
  • Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge‑sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data‑driven decision‑making

title: Brazil - Remote: Team Lead - Digital Twin Platform
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the “Control Room” and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s “Visualizations” and that the “Data Pipelines” are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert' : When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a 'deliver fast' mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Location

Fully remote position.

Full Time / Part Time: Full-time

Employee Group: Temporary

Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience.
