Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.

Responsabilidades

  • Inspeção e Integridade: Planejar, acompanhar e aprovar inspeções de dutos e equipamentos, garantindo atendimento à NR‑13 e padrões de integridade.

  • Conhecimento: Avaliação de defeitos (API 579/ASME B31.G), ASME B31.8/B31.8S, PIGs, SCC, soldagem e reparos, ArcGIS/Google Earth, gestão de riscos e contratos.

description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027” ) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Manager, reporting to both FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager, will be a key member of the FIFA27 team. This role involves close coordination with key stakeholders to meet operational, environmental, and service quality standards.

The position is responsible for developing, coordinating implementation, and overseeing sustainable cleaning and waste management strategies and operations from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This includes leading upstream and downstream waste management and ensuring a seamless, high-quality tournament experience in line with FIFA’s and regional sustainability standards.

The ideal candidate will combine event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management expertise with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the primary liaison between FIFA Functional Areas, Local Entities, contractors, and external stakeholders for sustainable cleaning and waste management services.
  • Lead and manage cleaning and waste management team, ensuring efficiency and high performance.
  • Develop and implement the Sustainable Waste management strategy and cleaning operational plan, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s requirements.
  • Develop and manage sustainable cleaning and waste management services budget, ensuring cost control and operational efficiency.
  • Lead the planning, installation, and operations of temporary waste management infrastructure across stadiums, training sites, and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Ensure full integration of cleaning and waste management requirements, maximizing the use of existing venue infrastructure while meeting FIFA standards and event operational needs.
  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery of sustainable cleaning and waste management services, managing resources, partners, suppliers, and contractors to ensure successful execution.
  • Conduct site visits to validate operational readiness, ensuring feasibility, quality, and compliance with operational needs.
  • Oversee the planning and delivery of temporary power, lighting, and other essential technical services for Resource Recovery Centers.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA’s facility management standards.
  • Collaborate with stadium facility management teams, suppliers, and local authorities to guarantee operational readiness by the highest sustainability standards.
  • Provide regular updates to the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager on key milestones, issues, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate with local authorities the process to secure necessary permits and approvals.
  • Track and report on project progress, identifying risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation in service planning and delivery.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Resource Management, Economics, Sustainability, Facility Management or a related field.
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience planning and executing sustainable cleaning and waste management services for major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of leading cleaning and waste management service teams in FIFA tournaments or similar global events.
  • Experience in budget management, procurement, and supplier coordination.
  • Strong understanding of stakeholders’ requirements and responsibilities to deliver efficient and sustainable operations.
  • Extensive knowledge of cleaning and waste management delivery, temporary infrastructure, and venue technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Senior Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Manager is responsible for the day‑to‑day coordination, and delivery of accreditation services for assigned client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Working within the established tournament accreditation framework, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, FIFA27 Accreditation teams and functional areas, the role ensures that client group accreditation requirements are delivered in line with defined FIFA accreditation policies, access control protocols, and agreed service standards.

  • Monitor readiness and proactively identify delivery risks, escalating issues as required.

  • Team Leadership & Support:

  • Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:

title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), which for the first time is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams’ time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

Your profile

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.

Team & Contractor Coordination

  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

Your profile

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Venue Design Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Venue Design Manager reports to FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and FIFA Senior Venue Design Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ requires venue design of as a key central delivery to fully integrate and visually represent all operations, legacy information and complementary structures required for the tournament. The Venue Design Manager is responsible for leading and implementing the venue design from block planning through to final design across a cluster of official FIFA stadiums and venues.

Role to transition into onsite Venue Overlay Manager during final Event.

Key responsibilities

Raw Data Management

  • Reception, validation and conversion of raw data into clean base CADs

Application of FIFA Drawing Standards:

  • Drawing updates according to FIFA standards and templates (layers, colour codes, line styles, annotation, legends, layouts, naming conventions etc.)

Drawing Updates:

  • Integration of operational content (space allocation, perimeters, flow data, capacities, space tags), legacy information (base infrastructure, legacy usage/annotation/signage) and complementary structures (fences, commodities, FF&E layouts etc.) as required.

Application of BIM 360 workflows:

  • Management and interaction of central database for drawing development, communication, change requests and publications.

Implementation of Space Requirements:

  • Application of requirements according to FIFA Event Platform (EP) and venue limitations.

Drawing Publications:

  • Delivery of drawings sets according to inspections and project timelines (site plans, levels, seating maps, pitch plans, catwalks, sections, detailed layouts etc.)

Ongoing Collaboration:

  • Continuous collaboration and support for Venue Management and FIFA Functional Areas.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Services and Overlay teams, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.

Your profile

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing multi-venue overlay projects, from design to delivery, preferably for major sporting events (e.g., FIFA, Olympic Games).
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure and spatial planning.
  • Excellent organisational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent drawing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver to tight deadlines.
  • Knowledge of local construction regulations and permitting processes in host country (desirable).
    Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  2. the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  3. efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions projec, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC

Your profile

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.
Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.
A área de Contabilidade é responsável pelo registro, controle e análise das operações financeiras da companhia, garantindo conformidade com normas contábeis e suporte às áreas de negócio. Os principais desafios incluem lidar com alto volume de informações, prazos rigorosos de fechamento e constante atualização frente às normas contábeis e processos internos.

  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;

  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos: Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Manager, Volunteer Operations FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities.

In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability.

Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities.

We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

Key responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management.
    FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

Your profile

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Start date: 01 March (tentative or to be agreed)

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates’s football.

title: Interpretation Geophysicist
description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Overview

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Responsibilities

  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.

About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).

title: GIG- Operador de Equipamentos
description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ✈️

A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto do Galeão (GIG) !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Informações adicionais

Estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos, então faça o seu cadastro e venha fazer parte do time dnata Brasil!

dnata Brasil — faça parte do futuro da aviação. ✈️

É quase impossível você andar em um aeroporto no Brasil e não ver o logotipo da dnata . Somos um dos maiores hubs da dnata no mundo, atuando em 26 aeroportos , de norte a sul do país, e em mais de 140 aeroportos em todo o planeta. Sempre em terra, garantindo que cada atendimento aconteça com segurança, responsabilidade e excelência .

Aqui, você fará parte de um time com mais de 6.000 profissionais da aviação , especialistas em assistência em solo , atuando desde o atendimento ao passageiro , passando pelo manuseio de bagagens, operações de rampa e chegando até o pushback da aeronave , para a aviação comercial e executiva.

Atendemos mais de 20 companhias aéreas e realizamos mais de 250 mil turnarounds por ano . ✨

title: Professor(a) de Português (Produção Textual) - Fundamental 2 - Barra da Tijuca/RJ
description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de Português (Produção Textual) para o Fundamental 2. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de Português (Produção Textual) alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Letras;
  • Experiência com Fundamental 2.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírio colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída;
  • Inglês.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Visit our careers site for more information;

title: Project Manager
description:
Intermoor, Acteon's Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start-up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path.

InterMoor is looking to add a Project Manager to the team. The Project Manager's primary responsibility is to plan, direct, and coordinate activities of a single or multiple projects to ensure that goals or objectives of project are safely accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters and the customer receives a quality product or service which meets or exceeds all of the customer requirements.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Plan, direct and coordinate the activities of one or more projects, ensuring that the objectives are achieved safely, within the established deadlines and budget limits
  • Structure and monitor project budgets, providing revenue and cost analysis, including the appropriate credit releases, as well as participate in the revenue and cost forecast process
  • Develop and maintain the project schedule with resource allocation, including detailed work breakdown structure (WBS)
  • Manage projects and assigned teams on a daily basis, including planning operations and supervising operational personnel in the field, reviewing procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation in all phases of the project, ensuring compliance with schedule and budget
  • Act in the daily monitoring of projects and systems to identify deviations and ensure that activities occur as planned
  • Propose and implement solutions to mitigate operational downtime or delays that impact the customer or the profitability of the project
  • Support customers in the elaboration of design concepts and technical specifications
  • Conduct presentations and support commercial activities
  • When applicable, coordinate with the Operations and Commercial areas the development of proposals and bids
  • Review and approve quality plans and technical procedures, as well as develop procedures for subsea projects, when necessary
  • Analyze proposals and project plans to define deadlines, budget limits, procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation by phase
  • Define the work plan and the sizing of teams for each phase of the project, informing the personnel needs to the Operations area
  • Align work plans with project teams, assigning responsibilities, scope, and levels of authority
  • Direct and coordinate project activities to ensure execution on time and within the approved budget
  • Review status reports and adjust timelines or plans as needed
  • Oversee the issuance of requisitions that are not related to general maintenance and repairs, as well as review and approve supplier invoices
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical and financial reports for management, customers or other stakeholders
  • Together with Technical Support, provide support to project teams, offering technical guidance and support in solving problems
  • Review and approve project invoices and support the financial area in matters related to accounts receivable with customers
  • Carry out national and international trips, as needed
  • Maintain mandatory training according to management guidelines
  • Work in close collaboration with the Commercial Department in the analysis of ITTs and submission of proposals, ensuring a well-defined scope, technical skills, necessary equipment and full understanding of terms, conditions and pricing
  • In coordination with the Commercial area, make presentations to customers about new technologies or solutions that improve their performance
  • Implement QHSE Management Systems and ensure compliance with local regulations
  • Verify the compliance of the systems with all Technical, Operational and QHSE bulletins
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical or financial reports as required by management, customers or other stakeholders

Required

  • Complete higher education in Engineering, preferably Naval Engineering
  • Active CREA registration
  • Desirable post-graduation in a related area
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Desirable good knowledge in Autocad, Office package, AutoCAD®, SolidWorks, Orcaflex
  • Desirable experience of at least 8 years in the design and/or installation of permanent anchoring systems for units such as FPSOs, FSOs, FSUs or CALM buoys, among others
  • Experience in developing offshore operating procedures for subsea installation and/or construction
  • Good vision and business understanding
  • Experience in installing flexible and umbilical risers
  • Expertise in installation analysis
  • Experience using OrcaFlex software
  • Experience in developing tenders, including methodologies, schedules, and financial estimates/calculations
  • Experience in team leadership and team member guidance

Jacaré/Rio de Janeiro.

Descrição Sumária

Conduzir análises técnicas de segurança de medicamentos, alimentos, cosméticos e produtos para saúde e garantir a conformidade regulatória dos produtos da FQM, por meio da avaliação de eventos adversos, implementação e manutenção do Sistema de Farmacovigilância, cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias e suporte às áreas internas, assegurando a proteção do paciente e a integridade dos nossos produtos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Receber, avaliar, qualificar e investigar casos individuais de segurança (ICSRs), incluindo eventos adversos graves e não graves.

  • Determinar causalidade utilizando metodologias reconhecidas, assegurando consistência técnica na tomada de decisão.
  • Acompanhar literatura científica e atualizar sistemas de segurança conforme requisitos de compliance.
  • Realizar submissões de casos à Anvisa e demais autoridades regulatórias dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Preparar documentação técnica e de suporte para Registro e Pós-registro, alinhada às normas vigentes.
  • Elaborar e revisar relatórios periódicos de segurança (PSUR, RMPs e RPBR).
  • Participar de auditorias internas, autoinspeções e avaliações de conformidade, garantindo alinhamento às diretrizes de Farmacovigilância.
  • Apoiar a implementação e manutenção do Sistema Local de Farmacovigilância, incluindo monitoramento de fornecedores e parceiros.
  • Acompanhar atualizações regulatórias e avaliar impactos sobre produtos e processos internos.
  • Elaborar, revisar e acompanhar Acordos de Farmacovigilância (SDEA) com parceiros nacionais e internacionais.
  • Atuar em interface com Assuntos Regulatórios, Qualidade, SAC, equipes médicas e parceiros externos para ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos internos sobre fluxos, responsabilidades e requisitos da Farmacovigilância.
  • Contribuir ativamente para fortalecer a cultura de segurança do paciente dentro da organização.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Farmácia, Biomedicina ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: 3 a 5 anos na área de Farmacovigilância.
  • Conhecimento prático das Boas Práticas de Farmacovigilância (ANVISA / ICH).
  • Conhecimentos das Normas de Vigilância nacionais e internacionais (Anvisa, EMA, ICH, FDA).
  • Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e Boas Práticas de Farmacovigilância (GVP).
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas eletrônicos de segurança (UltraVig/ UltraCOS, Argus, ArisG ou similares).

title: Implementations Accountant
description:
Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta’s tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

Problems You’ll Solve

  • Collaborate with new fund clients to collect data and advise on best accounting practices within Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post‑sales
  • Identify process and quality improvements and highlight them to appropriate leadership
  • Create balanced, accurate quarterly financial statements from, at times, unstructured client data

The Team You'll Work With

As an Implementations Accountant, you will join a team that supports new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating, and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders.

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Accountant will exhibit a high degree of problem‑solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject‑matter expertise to provide customers with a world‑class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience in a role with a finance or accounting background
  • Strong accounting analysis with the ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Committed to team and project success, emotionally intelligent in navigating relationships, transparent and forthright when communicating information, and passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Ability to communicate in both written and verbal formats in a timely and appropriate manner
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Acumen in or knowledge of accounting with a specific focus in venture, hedge fund, and/or private equity
  • Familiarity as an end user with Carta or other financial dataset or accounting software programs

Compensation

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our expected cash compensation range for this role is:

  • $81,000 - $85,000 in New York, New York
  • $81,000 - $85,000 in San Francisco, California
  • $72,900 - $76,500 in Seattle, Washington

Equal Employment Opportunity
